Here, we present the latent causal diffusion (LCD), a generative model that frames single-cell gene expression as a stationary diffusion process observed under measurement noise. LCD outperforms established approaches in predicting the distributional shifts of unseen perturbation combinations in single-cell RNA-sequencing screens while simultaneously learning a mechanistic dynamical system of gene regulation. To interpret these learned dynamics, we develop an approach we call causal linearization via perturbation responses (CLIPR), which yields an approximation of the direct causal effects between all genes modeled by the diffusion. CLIPR provably identifies causal effects under a linear drift assumption and recovers causal structure in both simulated systems and a genome-wide perturbation screen, where it clusters genes into coherent functional modules and resolves causal relationships that standard differential expression analysis cannot. The LCD-CLIPR framework bridges generative modeling with causal inference to predict unseen perturbation effects and map the underlying regulatory mechanisms of the transcriptome.
papers.venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America

summary.takeaway: 提出latent causal diffusion (LCD)生成模型，将单细胞基因表达建模为测量噪声下观测的平稳扩散过程，在预测未见扰动组合的分布偏移上优于既有方法，同时学习基因调控的机制动力学系统；并开发CLIPR（causal linearization via perturbation responses）近似直接因果效应，在线性漂移假设下可证明识别因果效应，在模拟系统和全基因组扰动筛选中恢复因果结构。
summary.methods: 方法：LCD将单细胞基因表达建模为平稳扩散过程并在测量噪声下观测；CLIPR通过扰动响应进行因果线性化，在线性漂移假设下可证明识别因果效应；在模拟系统和全基因组扰动筛选上验证，聚类基因成功能模块并解析标准差异表达分析无法解决的因果关系。
summary.relevance: 与单细胞扰动、机制推理主题直接相关：预测未见扰动效应并映射转录组调控机制。
summary.caveat: 摘要称CLIPR的可证明识别依赖线性漂移假设；摘要未提供具体数据集名称和量化性能数值。

papers.title: CARA: Causally Guided Retrieval Agent for Question Answering
papers.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation over text-rich knowledge graphs requires identifying evidence that contributes to answering a question, rather than merely matching its textual content. Existing agentic retrievers adaptively balance global search and multi-hop exploration but primarily rely on textual similarity to guide retrieval. We propose CARA, a training-free, CAusally guided Retrieval Agent that explicitly evaluates the causal relevance of retrieved evidence through two complementary criteria: consequentiality, measuring whether adding evidence improves answerability, and essentiality, assessing whether removing evidence weakens answerability. CARA integrates these assessments with path consistency to guide graph exploration and employs reciprocal rank fusion to aggregate evidence from multiple agents. We evaluate CARA on three STaRK datasets and augment STaRK with ground-truth answers to enable downstream question answering evaluation. Experimental results demonstrate that CARA consistently outperforms existing retrievers. CARA also improves answer quality and faithfulness while examining fewer graph nodes and requiring fewer retrieval operations. These findings demonstrate that causal relevance assessment enables more focused and effective agentic graph retrieval, improving both retrieval performance and downstream question answering.

summary.takeaway: 提出CARA，一种免训练的因果引导检索智能体，通过两个互补标准显式评估检索证据的因果相关性：consequentiality（加入证据是否提升可答性）和essentiality（移除证据是否削弱可答性），并结合路径一致性和互惠排名融合聚合多智能体证据；在三个STaRK数据集上一致优于现有检索器，同时检查更少图节点、需更少检索操作，并提升答案质量与忠实度。
summary.methods: 方法：CARA为免训练检索智能体，评估因果相关性（consequentiality与essentiality），整合路径一致性指导图探索，使用reciprocal rank fusion聚合多智能体证据；在三个STaRK数据集上评估，并将STaRK扩充真值答案以支持下端问答评估。
summary.relevance: 与检索增强、知识图谱主题相关：针对文本丰富知识图谱的检索增强生成。
summary.caveat: 摘要未给出具体性能数值或基线名称；评估范围限于三个STaRK数据集及其扩充版本。

papers.title: OpCredit: Operation-Aware Policy Learning for Agentic Knowledge Graph Question Answering
papers.abstract: Agentic knowledge graph question answering(KGQA) relies on sequences of executable operations, but trajectory-level rewards obscure their individual contributions. Successful trajectories may contain ineffective operations, while failed trajectories may contain useful ones. To assess individual operations, we propose OpCredit, an operationaware policy-learning framework that combines downstream outcome credit with immediate transition credit: Branch Outcome Credit (BOC) reuses ordinary rollouts to compare terminal task rewards observed after different operations under matched navigation contexts; Frontier Transition Credit (FTC) measures operation-induced changes in answer-conditioned frontier potential. The two complementary signals jointly supervise the corresponding decision spans during training, while inference uses only the learned policy and standard KG interface. Experiments on ComplexWebQuestions, WebQSP, and GrailQA across three backbones demonstrate consistent improvements in KGQA performance.

summary.takeaway: 提出OpCredit，一种操作感知的策略学习框架，通过结合下游结果信用与即时转移信用来评估智能体知识图谱问答中单个操作：Branch Outcome Credit (BOC)复用普通rollout，在匹配导航上下文下比较不同操作后的终端任务奖励；Frontier Transition Credit (FTC)衡量操作引起的答案条件前沿潜力变化；两种互补信号在训练中联合监督对应决策片段，推理仅用学习策略和标准KG接口。在ComplexWebQuestions、WebQSP和GrailQA三个骨干上一致提升KGQA性能。
summary.methods: 方法：OpCredit结合BOC与FTC两种信用信号监督训练；在ComplexWebQuestions、WebQSP、GrailQA数据集及三个骨干模型上实验。
summary.relevance: 与知识图谱主题相关：智能体知识图谱问答中的策略学习与信用分配。
summary.caveat: 摘要未给出具体性能数值或对比基线细节。

papers.title: Gene Regulatory Network Inference reveals tcf4 as a key a player in neuroblastoma gene expression circuitry
papers.abstract: Neuroblastoma (NB), a pediatric cancer arising from disrupted sympathetic neuron differentiation, exhibits marked heterogeneity and limited therapeutic options. To better understand its molecular circuitry dynamics, we applied CardamomOT, a novel Gene Regulatory Network (GRN) inference framework, to single-cell RNA-seq data from patient-derived tumoroids. This approach models gene regulation via piecewise deterministic Markov processes, capturing transcriptional bursting and protein-mediated feedback, overcoming limitations of RNA velocity (e.g., gene independence and lack of biological time). We identified a continuous chromaffin-to-sympathoblast differentiation trajectory along which we selected 85 dynamically relevant genes enriched in cell cycle and DNA replication functions. Notably, 9 genes overlapped with those driving normal sympathoadrenal differentiation, underscoring tumor-normal tissue similarity. The inferred 85-genes network reproduced quite well experimental gene expression patterns in silico, and allowed to predict protein-level dynamics. Furthermore, it allowed to predict the effect of perturbations (both knock-out and overexpression) of hub genes (e.g., tcf4 and PLK1). We show that those perturbations significantly altered cell fate proportions in silico, with tcf4 KO increasing chromaffin-like cells and reducing proliferative late sympathoblasts. Predictions regarding tcf4 were tested using drug inhibition as a proxy for the gene KO. Using the BET inhibitor JQ1 indeed induced profound effect on the transcriptomic identity of our tumoroids. All of the 50 predicted tcf4 target genes were found to be significantly altered by JQ1 treatment. Finally cell fate proportions were also altered ex vivo closely resembling the predicted output. Our work therefore demonstrates that NB tumoroids retain a dynamic, differentiation-like architecture amenable to GRN modeling. Predicted druggable targets offer testable therapeutic avenues, including repurposing BET inhibitors or PLK1 inhibitors, potentially in combination.

summary.takeaway: 应用CardamomOT（一种基于分段确定性马尔可夫过程的GRN推断框架）于患者来源肿瘤球的单细胞RNA-seq数据，识别出从chromaffin到sympathoblast的连续分化轨迹及85个动态相关基因（富集细胞周期和DNA复制功能，其中9个与正常交感肾上腺分化驱动基因重叠），推断网络能较好复现实验表达模式并预测蛋白水平动力学及枢纽基因（如tcf4和PLK1）扰动效应；用BET抑制剂JQ1作为tcf4 KO代理验证，50个预测tcf4靶基因均显著改变，细胞命运比例改变与预测吻合。
summary.methods: 方法：CardamomOT通过分段确定性马尔可夫过程建模基因调控，捕获转录爆发和蛋白介导反馈；应用于患者来源肿瘤球scRNA-seq；识别分化轨迹并选85个动态基因；预测敲除和过表达扰动效果；用BET抑制剂JQ1（作为tcf4 KO代理）进行实验验证。
summary.relevance: 与GRN / Regulon主题相关：基因调控网络推断及其在神经母细胞瘤中的应用。
summary.caveat: 摘要指出RNA velocity存在基因独立性和缺乏生物时间等局限；预测关于tcf4的结果使用药物抑制作为基因KO代理进行测试；研究基于患者来源肿瘤球，摘要未报告临床终点。

papers.title: Reflective Compositional Grounding for Natural-Language-to-SPARQL
papers.abstract: Natural-language query generation over large knowledge graphs embodies the classical vocabulary problem in human-systems communication. Questions express concepts through wording and compositions that can differ substantially from the target schema, while limited model context requires selective access to schema information. We present an NL2SPARQL framework that places conceptual compositionality at the center of query interpretation and connects it to the relational composition required for binding and query construction. A fixed concept encoder represents compound expressions jointly, and schema candidates are ranked using semantic similarity, type compatibility, and hierarchy proximity. Reflective refinement critically examines how the grounded meanings are realized through argument bindings, joins, and operator scope. Diagnosed semantic discrepancies guide revisions to the responsible stage. We formalise a monotone refinement discipline that accumulates scoped interpretation requirements and establish conditions under which changes to the composed process preserve previously validated interpretations. Across five benchmark/knowledge-graph targets, mean schema recall@10 increases from 0.712 to 0.837. With retrieval held fixed, reflective prompt rewriting adds 2.27-3.33 answer-F1 points. These experiments evaluate the grounding and refinement mechanisms, while the formal analysis specifies the stronger requirements for conservative adaptation across queries.

summary.takeaway: 提出一个以概念组合性为核心的NL2SPARQL框架，将自然语言中复合表达的理解与查询构建所需的关系组合相连接，并通过反射式精炼机制修正语义落地偏差。
summary.methods: 采用固定的概念编码器联合表示复合表达式；基于语义相似度、类型兼容性和层次邻近度对schema候选进行排序；通过反射式精炼检查参数绑定、连接和运算符作用域中的落地含义，并据此修订对应阶段；形式化了一种单调精炼纪律，并在五个基准/知识图谱目标上进行实验评估。
summary.relevance: 该工作直接面向知识图谱上的自然语言查询生成（NL2SPARQL），属于知识图谱主题下的自然语言接口与语义解析研究。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅报告了schema recall@10从0.712提升至0.837，以及在检索固定时反射式提示改写带来2.27–3.33个答案F1点提升；未说明所涉基准/知识图谱的具体名称、模型规模或计算成本，形式化分析的条件也仅限摘要所述范围。
